run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum average sum partition of an array into K subarrays
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample arrays and partition counts to verify correct maximum average sum
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to improve time complexity from O(n^2*K) using optimized DP transitions
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach for maximum average sum partition array problem
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which partitions an array into at most K contiguous subarrays to maximize sum of averages
